facts.fact: 第五年 Grand Exam 与 Mathé’s Feast 同周举行、在 First Healer 的 feast day 收官，被视为重大而受尊崇的传统
facts.anchor: The tradition of the fifth-year Grand Exam coinciding with this week

facts.fact: Lantern Night 次日凌晨，Jehan 提着鞋悄悄回房；Sab 从 Paradis Ree 的房间出来，向他道 Mathé’s luck, Jehan
facts.anchor: He’d emerged from the room belonging to Paradis Ree

facts.fact: Estiene 把 Jehan 的肩抓得深到出血，事后提出替他治愈，Jehan 拒绝，Estiene 便训他对自己身体太不顾惜
facts.anchor: Estiene had scratched him deeply enough to draw blood

facts.fact: Estiene 对 Jehan 说：你已经不能再想干什么就干什么了，你是我的
facts.anchor: You can’t just do whatever you want anymore, you’re mine

facts.fact: Jehan 想：Estiene 已经当了二十三年 Marcelle，一脉之中只有五人认识 Jehan，而知道 Jehan 对他心意的只有约两小时
facts.anchor: only five of them knowing Jehan, and only—what, two hours?

facts.fact: 一条黑影从书桌与椅子的阴影里分离出来，以几乎无声的脚步逼近；Jehan 及时转身，躲开挥向头部的一击
facts.anchor: A shadow had separated from the shadows of his desk and chair

facts.fact: 若不是在 Blavot 的 ring 里练了两年本能，他来不及转身；他扭身用小腿正面蹬出足以致伤的一脚，对手仍以体重压过他的防线
facts.anchor: If he’d not spent two years in Blavot’s ring

facts.fact: 那人用湿布捂住 Jehan 的口鼻；Jehan 抓腕、憋气、聚起魔力想伤人，最后魔力与意识一起消失
facts.anchor: Warm curtains closed in and Jehan’s magic, along with his thoughts, faded to nothing.
